title: One sample of ten resistors
intro: The same resistor line as item 6.1: the population of all resistors it makes has mean μ = 100 Ω and standard deviation σ = 2 Ω. An inspector pulled **one sample of 10 resistors** and measured them (Ω). Their mean x̄ and standard deviation s are statistics: they estimate μ and σ, and they would come out a little different for another 10 resistors.
